interface_changes: New list_files(root) and read_file(root, path, start_line=1, end_line=None, max_bytes=65536)
Host supplies trusted root and byte budget; no model tool dispatcher or root argument exposed in demo CLI
Canonical containment, visible-path policy, allowlisted regular UTF-8 text, bounded read and inclusive line selection
FileAccessError codes: permission_denied, not_found, unsupported_content, io_error; invalid ranges/budgets raise ValueError
FileReadResult: path, start_line, end_line, content, truncated, next_start_line; no max-lines independent exercise implemented
budget_strategy: Reject files above max_bytes; stat precheck then at most max_bytes+1 bytes read to detect growth. Line ranges apply only to files within whole-file budget.

blocked.reason: Windows WinError 1314: process lacks symlink creation privilege

next_prerequisites: Rerun symlink test and demo in an environment that supports symlink creation

unresolved_risks: Canonical path checks do not prevent concurrent path replacement (TOCTOU) or hard-link aliases; not an OS sandbox
Listing has per-file byte limits but no total directory/time/result-count budget
Suffix and UTF-8 checks do not detect secrets inside allowed source files
learning_status: Implementation and test evidence only; no assertion of learner mastery
